newsitem.title: CANADA: National Bank Canada joins Latam group.
newsitem.headline: National Bank Canada joins Latam group.

text.p: National Bank of Canada said on Tuesday it has finalized its acquisition of a US$75 million stake in an investors' group led by Chilean financial services group Infisa S.A.
The group will invest about US$750 million in banks, brokerages, insurance companies and pension fund management firms in Latin American countries, National Bank said in a statement.
"The group's first acquisitions will involve Chile's Banco Concepcion and Venezuela's Banco Consolidado," National Bank said.
National Bank's investment was made through its subsidiary Natcan Holdings International.
The other members of the group are Blackstone Capital Partners II Banking Fund L.P., Chase Capital Partners, and Hicks, Muse, Tate & Furst Inc.

"This is a very promising market which will no doubt generate many interesting business opportunities for the National Bank and its commercial clients," said Gaby Touma, National Bank's senior vice-president of international operations.
